item.title: Strait of Hormuz traffic falls to new low as Iran-backed group kills 6 in Red Sea
item.description: The conflict between the U.S. and Iran has spread to the Red Sea and another strategic shipping route.

item.title: Eli Lilly takes aim at illicit market for its experimental weight-loss drug
item.description: The pharmaceutical company is filing lawsuits against six outlets selling versions of its promising but unapproved weight-loss drug, retatrutide.

item.title: CPI report shows inflation eased in July to a 3.4% annual pace
item.description: The CPI report was in line with economists' expectations, marking the second consecutive month with cooler price pressures.

item.title: David Crowley beats progressive Francesca Hong in Wisconsin gubernatorial primary
item.description: David Crowley unexpectedly beat a progressive candidate in the Democratic primary for Wisconsin governor, and will face Republican Rep. Tom Tiffany on the ballot in November.

item.title: Moderate Crowley upsets democratic socialist Hong in Wisconsin gubernatorial primary
item.description: Moderate David Crowley narrowly won Wisconsin's Democratic gubernatorial primary, upsetting democratic socialist Francesca Hong, CBS News projects. Ed O'Keefe explains how the race unfolded.

item.title: Trump addresses secret Air Force One swap as new questions swirl
item.description: President Trump secretly left Turkey last month following a NATO summit on a different plane than Air Force One even though many others were still allowed to board. Mr. Trump on Tuesday made his first public comments about the secret switch. Nancy Cordes reports.

item.title: Eye Opener: Strong storms leave behind major destruction after sweeping across Midwest
item.description: Millions are still at risk of flooding after powerful storms swept across the Midwest, leaving a trail of destruction. Plus, President Trump makes his first public comments about the secret swap off Air Force One in Turkey. All that and all that matters in today's Eye Opener.

item.title: White House asked DOJ about new Reflecting Pool case against David Hearn
item.description: Earlier this month, however, federal prosecutors moved to dismiss the case, citing new information that the damage was caused by a "botched installation" by a contractor, not vandalism.

item.title: Fighter jets intercept civilian plane over Geneva, Ohio
item.description: F-16 fighter jets intercepted a civilian plane that violated a temporary flight restriction over Geneva, Ohio, where President Trump attended the 2026 Patriot Games.

item.title: Deadly storms, tornadoes slam Midwest, causing widespread power outages
item.description: More than 700,000 customers in the Midwest were still without power early Wednesday after perilous thunderstorms and tornadoes hit the region.

item.title: Colombia earthquake rescue volunteer reacts after pulling survivor from rubble
item.description: Rescue workers are racing against the clock to free trapped survivors of the Colombia earthquake. Some success stories are emerging. CBS News' Lilia Luciano has more on the efforts.

item.title: How the Secret Service is cracking down on card-skimming scams
item.description: A Secret Service analyst told CBS News a single skimming device can net a scammer up to $1 million.

item.title: Norah O'Donnell: What I learned from my doctor about menopause
item.description: Norah O'Donnell sat down with her own doctor, Rachel Rubin, to tackle the important topic of menopause: How your body changes, why women may be needlessly suffering, and what you can actually do about it.

item.title: Estrogen, Testosterone and Menopause, Oh My!
item.description: This week on Healthful, urologist and sexual medicine specialist Dr. Rachel Rubin discusses how female bodies change during perimenopause and menopause — and explains why women may be suffering unnecessarily. Dr. Rubin and Norah discuss how vaginal hormones could save Medicare between $6 and $22 billion a year and even prevent urinary tract infections. Plus, Norah reveals her experience with menopause and hormone replacement therapy.

item.title: At least 1 dead, 172 rescued from ferry fire near Bali, Indonesia
item.description: One Indonesian teenager was killed when the vessel caught fire in rough seas.

item.title: Cartel sought to buy weapons in exchange for fentanyl, U.S. says
item.description: "In exchange for the weapons, the defendants paid in the form of fentanyl and methamphetamine imported into the United States for distribution," the Justice Department said.

item.title: Baby rescued from rubble in Colombia after devastating earthquake
item.description: Footage shared on social media shows a baby being rescued from the bloody arms of a man trapped underneath a destroyed building in Cali after a powerful earthquake struck Colombia.

item.title: Hospitals push for upfront payments as healthcare costs rise
item.description: Hospitals and other medical providers are increasingly asking for payment before providing care, collecting more of what patients might owe.

item.title: U.S. and Iran close to "peace arrangement or a deal," Pakistan says
item.description: The U.S. and Iran are close to agreeing on "some sort of arrangement," Pakistan's defense minister told Bloomberg on Tuesday.

item.title: What to know about today's total solar eclipse
item.description: The only total solar eclipse of 2026 will cross the Northern Hemisphere on Wednesday, Aug. 12, with a path of totality across parts of Greenland, Iceland and northern Spain. See when and where it will be visible.

item.title: Sen. Klobuchar projected winner of DFL primary in Minnesota governor's race
item.description: CBS News projects Sen. Amy Klobuchar, the heavy favorite, will win the Democratic primary in Minnesota's gubernatorial race and will face the Republican challenger in November.

item.title: Ilhan Omar projected winner of Democratic primary in Minnesota's 5th district
item.description: Minnesota Congresswoman Ilhan Omar has secured the Democratic nomination for reelection in the 2026 primary, CBS News projects.

item.title: Peggy Flanagan projected winner of Democratic primary for Senate in Minnesota
item.description: Lt. Gov. Peggy Flanagan has captured the Democratic nomination for U.S. Senate in the Minnesota primary election, CBS News projects.

item.title: Lisa Demuth projected winner of Republican primary in Minnesota governor's race
item.description: Minnesota House Speaker Lisa Demuth will win the Republican primary in Minnesota's gubernatorial race, CBS News projects.

item.title: Tafoya projected winner of GOP nomination for Senate in Minnesota primary
item.description: Michele Tafoya, a former television sports reporter, is the winner of the Republican nomination for Senate in the Minnesota primary election, CBS News projects.

item.title: ICE plans to give officers gloves that can deliver electric shocks
item.description: U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement officers may soon be outfitted with gloves that can deliver painful electric shocks that are intended to gain compliance from combative individuals.

item.title: Beach town mayor worries social media trend could lead to shark attack
item.description: Bay Head Mayor Bill Curtis worries that baiting sharks close to shore in order to take pictures and videos of them could be a recipe for disaster.

item.title: Analysis of key primary races in Minnesota, Wisconsin, South Carolina and more
item.description: CBS News political director Fin Gómez breaks down some of the key primary races unfolding on Tuesday as voters cast ballots in Minnesota, Wisconsin, Alabama, Connecticut, Vermont and South Carolina.

item.title: Trump Media sells $100,000 Truth Social data access, drawing scrutiny
item.description: Customers are paying up to $100,000 a month for faster access to Truth Social posts from President Trump and other top users of the social media platform.

item.title: Water safety tips as millions of Americans deal with intense heat wave
item.description: Ahead of the Fourth of July weekend, experts are warning about the dangers of rip currents and the importance of water safety.
